about.title: A clean Atyrau, together
about.lead: Taza AI is a civic eco-platform. Seen a dump, smoke or an oil product spill? Take a photo. AI helps describe the problem and drafts an official appeal to the akimat via eOtinish.
about.step1: Shoot the problem and mark the spot on the map.
about.step2: AI suggests a category and severity — you can edit everything.
about.step3: A ready text for eOtinish.kz, signed with your EDS or Digital ID.
about.basedOn: Taza AI is built on the open-source project {{name}} by {{author}} (MIT license). The map, feed and reports API come from it; AI, environmental data and appeals are added on top.
about.ethics: The AI never concludes that a law was broken or that a specific company is to blame. All AI estimates are preliminary and may be wrong.

appeal.title: Appeal via eOtinish
appeal.step1: Check the text and fix it if needed.
appeal.step2: Copy the text and download the photos.
appeal.step3: Open eOtinish.kz, sign in with eGov (digital signature or QR), choose the agency, paste the text and attach the photos.
appeal.step4: After sending, mark “I submitted the appeal” here.
appeal.generating: The AI is drafting the appeal…
appeal.weDontSend: Taza AI sends nothing on your behalf: you submit the appeal yourself. eOtinish fills in your applicant details from eGov.
